title.narrative: Chittagong Hill Tracts Watershed Co-Management Activity II (CHTWCA II)

description.narrative: (Bangladesh): USAID's Chittagong Hill Tracts Watershed Co-Management Activity II (CHTWCA II) will build regional resilience through an integrated, inclusive ecosystem co-management approach that conserves the natural habitats and protects the wildlife of the Chittagong Hill Tracts (CHT) watershed. CHTWCA II will provide technical assistance to the Forest Department, Ministry of CHT Affairs, Hill District Councils, Village Common Forest Management Committees, local civil society partners and forest-dependent communities. The activity will develop a CHT landscape level Integrated Watershed Management Action Plan and engage diverse stakeholders to protect the targeted forests and wetlands of CHT. It will also address gender based violence, empower marginalized communities and implement disaster risk reduction practices. With FY 2024 funds, the activity will raise awareness of forest and wildlife crimes; provide training on climate change adaptation, sustainable forest management, and social cohesion; reduce risks from natural disasters and advance market-linked resilient livelihoods. The activity aligns with the State-USAID Joint Strategic Plan and will advance the Indo-Pacific Strategy by mitigating threats to biodiversity, combating illegal logging and wildlife poaching, promoting environmental safeguards, fostering private sector engagement, and conserving ecosystems. The activity supports the U.S. government's objective of strengthening resilience to natural hazards and USAID's Climate Change Strategy. Funding for this activity contributes to Adaptation Indirect ($1m), Sustainable Landscapes-Indirect (300k), Combatting Wildlife Trafficking (300k), Microenterprises and Livelihoods ($200k), Small and Medium Sized Enterprises ($200k), Private Sector Engagement (200k) earmarks and key issues.
